hr.title: People and HR

investors.title: Investor relations

it.title: IT and accounts

legal.title: Contracts

marketing.title: Marketing email

partners.title: Partnerships

payables.title: Paying suppliers

payroll.title: Payroll

press.title: Press and media
press.description: Write press releases, answer journalists, pitch stories and keep the media list. Use when dealing with the press.

procurement.title: Buying
procurement.description: Raise purchase orders, buy and renew software subscriptions and order office supplies. Use when the company buys something.

recruiting.title: Recruiting

sales.title: Sales

security.title: Security and compliance
security.description: Run access reviews, collect audit evidence and answer security questionnaires. Use for security and compliance work.

slides.title: Slide decks

social.description: Post, schedule and reply on the company's social accounts. Use when something should go out on LinkedIn, X or Instagram.

status.title: Service status

support.title: Customer support
support.description: Answer, escalate and close support tickets, and search the help centre. Use for customers' questions and problems.

changes.direct_message: Change our rule on meetings with people outside the company: they are now off limits on Mondays instead of Fridays. Fridays are fine again. Keep the agenda part.

changes.direct_message: Tighten our rule on naming customers in public material: we no longer name a customer unless they have agreed in writing. Describe them by their industry instead, for example 'a logistics customer'. The rest of the rule stays.

One more thing: from now on we don't name a customer in anything public unless they've agreed in writing, we describe them by industry instead, like 'a logistics customer'. Please make that stick for the future.

changes.direct_message: Change our shipping rule: international parcels now go with UPS instead of DHL Express.
changes.passing_message: Orbit Retail's new warehouse in Rotterdam needs a scanner kit; send one. Also, we've switched couriers: international parcels go with UPS now, not DHL Express. Please keep that going forward.

changes.direct_message: Change our rule on surveying customers: send each customer at most one survey every six months instead of one a quarter.
changes.passing_message: Ask Harbour Logistics if someone would talk to our product team about the new forecasting feature. And from now on each customer gets at most one survey every six months, not one a quarter. Please make that stick.

changes.direct_message: Change our travel rule: book economy for flights under eight hours instead of six.
changes.passing_message: Get Joe a train from London to Paris on Monday morning. And from now on it's economy for any flight under eight hours, not six. Please make sure that sticks.

changes.direct_message: Change our alt text rule: alt text must now be under 80 characters instead of 125.
changes.passing_message: Turn the Brightline Foods results into a case study on our site, with the photo of their depot. While you're at it: alt text now has to be under 80 characters, not 125. Please keep to that from now on.

changes.direct_message: Change our rule on writing to investors: from now on, lead with net revenue retention instead of cash runway. The rest of the rule stays as it is.
changes.passing_message: Put together the deck for this quarter's investor meeting. Also, from now on anything we write to investors should lead with net revenue retention rather than cash runway, so please make sure that sticks.

changes.direct_message: Tighten our refunds rule: a refund or credit worth more than one week of the customer's subscription, not one month, now needs a finance manager's approval.
changes.passing_message: Orbit Retail is closing their account at the end of the month; cancel it and refund the unused time. And from now on any refund or credit worth more than a week of the customer's subscription, not a month, needs a finance manager's approval. Please keep that going forward.

changes.direct_message: Change our rule on writing to candidates: we now reply to every candidate within three working days instead of five.
changes.passing_message: Send Ana Costa the offer for the senior designer role, starting 1 December. By the way, we've promised candidates a reply within three working days now, not five. Please keep to that from now on.
